answer: Proposal: a key votes only once vouched by a bonded member, and each member may vouch for at most k newcomers per epoch, bond slashed when a vouched key is sanctioned by the jury. Clones can only vouch each other, an island of mutual credit that, like rain sinking into karst, never reaches the ledger. Each incumbent tends a garden of k slots, so N voting keys need N/k incumbents built slowly on accepted work. Cost per clone is linear, so this binds only while bond plus build time exceeds each slot's expected reward; vouch sales and slow fraud detection weaken it.
